     4→managed by the [ECK Operator](https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/cloud-on-k8s/current/index.html)
     5→
     6→## Supported Elastic Stack Resources
     7→
     8→The following Elastic Stack resources are currently supported. 
     9→

    11→- Kibana
    12→- Elastic Agent
    13→- Fleet Server
    14→- Beats
    15→- Logstash

    17→
    18→Additional resources will be supported in future releases of this Helm Chart.
    19→
    20→## Prerequisites
    21→
    22→- Kubernetes 1.21+
    23→- Elastic ECK Operator
    24→
    25→## Installing the Chart
    26→
    27→### Installing the ECK Operator
    28→
    29→Before using this chart, the Elastic ECK Operator is required to be installed within the Kubernetes cluster.
    30→Full installation instructions can be found within [our documentation](https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/cloud-on-k8s/current/k8s-installing-eck.html)
    31→
    32→To install the ECK Operator using Helm.
    33→
    34→```sh
    35→# Add the Elastic Helm Repository
    36→helm repo add elastic https://helm.elastic.co && helm repo update
    37→
    38→# Install the ECK Operator cluster-wide
    39→helm install elastic-operator elastic/eck-operator -n elastic-system --create-namespace
    40→```
    41→
    42→Additional ECK Operator Helm installation options can be found within [our documentation](https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/cloud-on-k8s/current/k8s-install-helm.html)
    43→
    44→### Installing the ECK Stack Chart
    45→
    46→The following will install the ECK-Stack chart using the default values, which will deploy an Elasticsearch [Quickstart Cluster](https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/cloud-on-k8s/current/k8s-deploy-elasticsearch.html), and a Kibana [Quickstart Instance](https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/cloud-on-k8s/current/k8s-deploy-kibana.html)
    47→
    48→```sh
    49→# Add the Elastic Helm Repository
    50→helm repo add elastic https://helm.elastic.co && helm repo update
    51→
    52→# Install the ECK-Stack helm chart
    53→# This will setup a 'quickstart' Elasticsearch and Kibana resource in the 'elastic-stack' namespace
    54→helm install my-release elastic/eck-stack -n elastic-stack --create-namespace
    55→```
    56→
    57→More information on the different ways to use the ECK Stack chart to deploy Elastic Stack resources
    58→can be found in [our documentation](https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/cloud-on-k8s/current/index.html).
    59→
    60→## Uninstalling the Chart
    61→
    62→To uninstall/delete the `my-release` deployment from the 'elastic-stack' namespace:
    63→
    64→```console
    65→helm delete my-release -n elastic-stack
    66→```
    67→
    68→The command removes all the Elastic Stack resources associated with the chart and deletes the release.
    69→
    70→## Configuration
    71→
    72→The following table lists the configurable parameters of the eck-stack chart and their default values.
    73→
    74→| Parameter | Description | Default |
    75→| --------- | ----------- | ------- |
    76→| `eck-elasticsearch.enabled` | If `true`, create an Elasticsearch resource (using the eck-elasticsearch Chart) | `true` |
    77→| `eck-kibana.enabled` | If `true`, create a Kibana resource (using the eck-kibana Chart) | `true` |
    78→| `eck-agent.enabled` | If `true`, create an Elastic Agent resource (using the eck-agent Chart) | `false` |
    79→| `eck-fleet-server.enabled` | If `true`, create a Fleet Server resource (using the eck-fleet-server Chart) | `false` |
    80→| `eck-logstash.enabled` | If `true`, create a Logstash resource (using the eck-logstash Chart) | `false` |
    81→| `eck-apm-server.enabled` | If `true`, create a standalone Elastic APM Server resource (using the eck-apm-server Chart) | `false` |
    82→
    83→Specify each parameter using the `--set key=value[,key=value]` argument to `helm install`.
    84→
    85→Alternatively, a YAML file that specifies the values for the above parameters can be provided while installing the chart. For example,
    86→
    87→```console
    88→helm install my-release -f values.yaml .
    89→```

# ECK-Stack

ECK Stack is a Helm chart to assist in the deployment of Elastic Stack components, which are
managed by the [ECK Operator](https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/cloud-on-k8s/current/index.html)

## Supported Elastic Stack Resources

The following Elastic Stack resources are currently supported. 

- Elasticsearch
- Kibana
- Elastic Agent
- Fleet Server
- Beats

```sh
# Add the Elastic Helm Repository
```

### Installing the ECK Stack Chart

  enabled: true

  fullnameOverride: "cmn"

    - name: master

        - metadata:

          spec:
            accessModes:
              - ReadWriteOnce
            resources:
              requests:
                storage: 10Gi
      podTemplate:
        spec:
          initContainers:
            - name: sysctl
              securityContext:
                privileged: true
                runAsUser: 0
              command: [ 'sh', '-c', 'sysctl -w vm.max_map_count=262144' ]
          containers:
            - name: elasticsearch
              env:
                - name: ES_JAVA_OPTS

                limits:
                  memory: 12Gi
                  cpu: 4
                requests:
                  memory: 12Gi
                  cpu: 4
    - name: data

      config:
        node.roles: [ "data", "ingest" ]
      volumeClaimTemplates:
        - metadata:
            name: elasticsearch-data # 데이터 경로에 대한 볼륨 마운트를 설정하지 않는 한 이 이름을 변경하지 마세요.
          spec:
            accessModes:
              - ReadWriteOnce
            resources:
              requests:
                storage: 400Gi
      podTemplate:
        spec:
          initContainers:
            - name: sysctl
              securityContext:
                privileged: true
                runAsUser: 0
              command: [ 'sh', '-c', 'sysctl -w vm.max_map_count=262144' ]
          containers:
            - name: elasticsearch
              image: harbor.cowave.kr/search/elasticsearch:9.1.2-ad-1.0.0
              imagePullPolicy: ifNotPresent
              env:
                - name: ES_JAVA_OPTS
                  value: "-Xms31g -Xmx31g"
              resources:
                limits:
                  memory: 48Gi
                  cpu: 16
                requests:
                  memory: 48Gi
                  cpu: 16
          imagePullSecrets:
            - name: search-harbor-cowave-secret
    - name: coord
      count: 10
      config:
        node.roles: [ ]
      volumeClaimTemplates:
        - metadata:

            accessModes:
              - ReadWriteOnce
            resources:
              requests:
                storage: 10Gi

        spec:
          initContainers:
            - name: sysctl
              securityContext:
                privileged: true

              command: [ 'sh', '-c', 'sysctl -w vm.max_map_count=262144' ]

            - name: elasticsearch

                  cpu: 8

    pathType: Prefix
    hosts:

      - host: cmn-keyword-analysis-api.danuricorp.com
        path: /
        service: cmn-es-data
        port: 9200

  enabled: true

  fullnameOverride: "cmn"
  elasticsearchRef:
    name: "cmn"

  ingress:
    enabled: true
    className: svc-search-internal
    pathType: Prefix
    hosts:
      - host: cmn-kibana.danuricorp.com
        path: /
    tls:
      enabled: true
      secretName: tls

# Default values for eck-kibana.
# This is a YAML-formatted file.

# Overridable names of the Kibana resource.
# By default, this is the Release name set for the chart,
# followed by 'eck-kibana'.
#
# nameOverride will override the name of the Chart with the name set here,
# so nameOverride: quickstart, would convert to '{{ Release.name }}-quickstart'
#
# nameOverride: "quickstart"
#
# fullnameOverride will override both the release name, and the chart name,
# and will name the Kibana resource exactly as specified.
#
# fullnameOverride: "quickstart"

# Version of Kibana.
#
version: 9.1.2

# Kibana Docker image to deploy
#
# image: docker.elastic.co/kibana/kibana:9.2.0-SNAPSHOT

# Labels that will be applied to Kibana.
#
labels: {}

# Annotations that will be applied to Kibana.
#
annotations: {}

# ** Deprecation Notice **
# The previous versions of this Helm Chart simply used the `spec` field here
# and allowed the user to specify any fields below spec that were templated directly
# into the final Kibana manifest. This is no long the preferred way to specify these
# fields and each field that is supported underneath `spec` is now directly specified
# in this values file. Currently both patterns are supported for backwards compatibility
# but we plan to remove the `spec` field in the future.
# spec: {}

# Count of Kibana replicas to create.
#
count: 1

# Reference to ECK-managed Elasticsearch resource.
#
elasticsearchRef: {}
  # name: eck-elasticsearch
  # Optional namespace reference to Elasticsearch resource.
  # If not specified, then the namespace of the Kibana resource
  # will be assumed.
  #
# namespace: default

# enterpriseSearchRef:

# ref: https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/kibana/current/settings.html
#
config: null

# The HTTP layer configuration for Kibana.
#
http:
  tls:
    selfSignedCertificate:
      disabled: true

# PodTemplate provides customisation options (labels, annotations, affinity rules,
# resource requests, and so on) for the Kibana pods
#
# podTemplate:

# Number of revisions to retain to allow rollback in the underlying deployment.
# By default, if not set, Kubernetes sets 10.
#
# revisionHistoryLimit: 2

# Used to check access from the current resource to a resource (for ex. Elasticsearch) in a different namespace.

#
# serviceAccountName: ""

# Settings for configuring stack monitoring.

#

  #   elasticsearchRefs:
  #   - name: monitoring
  #     namespace: observability
  # logs:
  #   elasticsearchRefs:
  #   - name: monitoring

# to the public internet, and as such is disabled by default.

# Also of note are `server.basePath`, and `server.rewriteBasePath` settings in the Kibana configuration.
#
# ref: https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/kibana/current/settings.html
#
# Each Cloud Service Provider has different requirements for setting up Ingress. Some links to common documentation are:
# - AWS: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/alb-ingress.html
# - GCP: https://cloud.google.com/kubernetes-engine/docs/concepts/ingress
# - Azure: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/aks/app-routing
# - Nginx: https://kubernetes.github.io/ingress-nginx/
#

  enabled: false

  # Annotations that will be applied to the Ingress resource. Note that some ingress controllers are controlled via annotations.
  #
  # Nginx Annotations: https://kubernetes.github.io/ingress-nginx/user-guide/nginx-configuration/annotations/
  #
  # Common annotations:
  #   kubernetes.io/ingress.class: gce          # Configures the Ingress resource to use the GCE ingress controller and create an external Application Load Balancer.
  #   kubernetes.io/ingress.class: gce-internal # Configures the Ingress resource to use the GCE ingress controller and create an internal Application Load Balancer.

  #
  # There are 3 supported path types:
  # - ImplementationSpecific
  # - Prefix
  # - Exact
  #
  # ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/services-networking/ingress/#path-types
  #

  # Hosts are a list of hosts included in the Ingress definition, with a corresponding path at which the Kibana service

  #
  # ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/services-networking/ingress/#name-based-virtual-hosting

  hosts:

  # - EKS:   https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/containers/serve-distinct-domains-with-tls-powered-by-acm-on-amazon-eks/
  # - Nginx: https://kubernetes.github.io/ingress-nginx/user-guide/tls/
  #
  # Kubernetes ingress TLS documentation:
  # ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/services-networking/ingress/#tls
  #
  tls:

완벽합니다. 이제 모든 필요한 정보를 수집했습니다. 종합적인 보고서를 작성하겠습니다.

## ECK Elasticsearch 클러스터에 NFS 볼륨 마운트 구현 가이드

### 1. infra/eck-stack 디렉토리 구조 분석

```
/infra/eck-stack/
├── Chart.yaml                          # 메인 차트 정의
├── README.md                            # 문서
├── templates/
│   ├── _helpers.tpl                    # 템플릿 헬퍼
│   ├── NOTES.txt
│   └── tests/                          # 테스트 템플릿
├── charts/
│   ├── eck-elasticsearch/              # Elasticsearch 서브차트
│   │   ├── Chart.yaml
│   │   ├── values.yaml                 # 기본 설정값
│   │   ├── templates/
│   │   │   ├── elasticsearch.yaml      # 메인 Elasticsearch 리소스
│   │   │   ├── ingress.yaml
│   │   │   ├── _helpers.tpl
│   │   │   └── tests/
│   │   └── LICENSE
│   └── eck-kibana/                     # Kibana 서브차트
│       ├── Chart.yaml
│       ├── values.yaml
│       └── templates/
├── dev/
│   └── values-dev.yaml                 # DEV 환경 설정값
└── prod/
    └── values-prod.yaml                # PROD 환경 설정값
```

**주요 특징:**
- ECK Stack은 Elasticsearch와 Kibana의 메타 차트
- 각각의 서브차트로 이루어짐
- 환경별 values 파일로 다양한 설정 관리

---

### 2. ECK Helm 차트의 PodTemplate과 Volumes 설정 방식

#### A. 현재 구조 (elasticsearch.yaml 템플릿)

```yaml
apiVersion: elasticsearch.k8s.elastic.co/v1
kind: Elasticsearch
metadata:
  name: {{ include "elasticsearch.fullname" . }}
  ...
spec:
  nodeSets:
    {{ toYaml .Values.nodeSets | nindent 4 }}  # nodeSets 전체가 values에서 주입됨
```

#### B. podTemplate에서 Volumes 설정 가능 위치

Elasticsearch values.yaml의 주석(Line 320-322)에 명시:
```yaml
# List of volumes that can be mounted by containers belonging to the pod.
# https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/storage/volumes
# volumes: []
```

**podTemplate 구조 (values.yaml, Line 178-322):**
```yaml
nodeSets:
  - name: default
    count: 1
    config: {...}
    podTemplate:
      spec:
        # affinity, containers, imagePullSecrets, initContainers,
        # nodeSelector, priorityClassName, securityContext, 
        # serviceAccountName, terminationGracePeriodSeconds, 
        # tolerations, topologySpreadConstraints
        
        # volumeMounts은 containers[].volumeMounts에서
        # volumes은 이 spec 레벨에서 정의 가능
        volumes: []  # <- 여기서 정의!
```

---

### 3. 현재 프로젝트의 기존 설정 상태

#### A. dev/values-dev.yaml 구조
```yaml
eck-elasticsearch:
  enabled: true
  fullnameOverride: dev-cmn
  nodeSets:
    - name: master
      count: 3
      config:
        node.roles: [ "master" ]
      volumeClaimTemplates:  # <- StatefulSet용 PVC 템플릿
        - metadata:
            name: elasticsearch-data
          spec:
            accessModes: [ReadWriteOnce]
            resources:
              requests:
                storage: 5Gi
      podTemplate:
        spec:
          initContainers: [...]
          containers:
            - name: elasticsearch
              image: harbor.cowave.kr/search/elasticsearch:9.1.2-ad-1.0.0
              imagePullPolicy: Always
              env: [...]
              resources: [...]
          imagePullSecrets: [...]
    
    - name: data
      count: 3
      volumeClaimTemplates: [...]  # 데이터 노드도 PVC 사용
      podTemplate: [...]
```

#### B. prod/values-prod.yaml 구조
- 더 큰 규모: master 3개, data 40개, coordinator 10개
- 각 노드타입별로 volumeClaimTemplates 사용
- PVC를 통한 Persistent Storage 활용

#### C. 핵심 발견사항
1. **현재는 volumeClaimTemplates만 사용** - StatefulSet의 동적 PVC 생성
2. **NFS 관련 설정 없음** - eck-stack에는 기존 NFS 설정 없음
3. **podTemplate은 존재** - volumes 추가 가능한 구조

---

### 4. 프로젝트의 다른 곳에서의 NFS 활용 패턴

#### A. pvc-shared/pvc-shared-nas.yaml (간단한 패턴)
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: prod-was-shared-data-pvc
spec:
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteMany              # NFS는 보통 RWM 사용
  storageClassName: nfs-filesystem
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 1Ti
```

#### B. artifactory-oss의 NFS PV/PVC 패턴 (복잡한 패턴)
```yaml
# PersistentVolume 정의
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolume
metadata:
  name: artifactory-data-pv
spec:
  mountOptions:
    - nfsvers=4,rsize=8192,wsize=8192,hard,timeo=600,retrans=3
  capacity:
    storage: {{ capacity }}
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  persistentVolumeReclaimPolicy: Retain
  nfs:
    server: {{ nfs_server_ip }}    # NFS 서버 IP
    path: "{{ nfs_mount_path }}"   # NFS 마운트 경로
    readOnly: false

---
# PersistentVolumeClaim 정의
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
apiVersion: v1
metadata:
  name: artifactory-data-pvc
spec:
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  storageClassName: ""           # PV와 selector로 매칭
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: {{ capacity }}
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      id: artifactory-data-pv
```

#### C. NFS 존재 여부 확인 결과
```
찾은 NFS 관련 설정들:
- /infra/pvc-shared/ : nfs-filesystem 스토리지클래스 사용
- /infra/psmdb-db/values.yaml : 주석 처리된 NFS 설정 예시
- /infra/artifactory-oss/ : PV/PVC 기반 NFS 설정
- /infra/streampark/ : nfs-filesystem 스토리지클래스 참조
- /infra/flink-kubernetes-operator/ : CRD에 nfs 정의
```

### 5. ECK Elasticsearch에 NFS 마운트 추가 방법

#### A. 방법 1: podTemplate에서 volumes 추가 (권장)

`values-dev.yaml` 또는 `values-prod.yaml`에 다음 추가:

```yaml
eck-elasticsearch:
  enabled: true
  fullnameOverride: dev-cmn
  nodeSets:
    - name: master
      count: 3
      config:
        node.roles: [ "master" ]
      volumeClaimTemplates:
        - metadata:
            name: elasticsearch-data
          spec:
            accessModes: [ReadWriteOnce]
            resources:
              requests:
                storage: 5Gi
      
      podTemplate:
        spec:
          initContainers:
            - name: sysctl
              securityContext:
                privileged: true
                runAsUser: 0
              command: [ 'sh', '-c', 'sysctl -w vm.max_map_count=262144' ]
          
          containers:
            - name: elasticsearch
              image: harbor.cowave.kr/search/elasticsearch:9.1.2-ad-1.0.0
              imagePullPolicy: Always
              env:
                - name: ES_JAVA_OPTS
                  value: "-Xms8g -Xmx8g"
              
              # volumeMounts 추가
              volumeMounts:
                - name: nfs-backup          # volumes에서 정의한 이름
                  mountPath: /mnt/nfs       # Pod 내 마운트 경로
                - name: nfs-snapshot
                  mountPath: /mnt/snapshot
              
              resources:
                limits:
                  memory: 10Gi
                  cpu: 4
                requests:
                  memory: 10Gi
                  cpu: 4
          
          # volumes 정의 (podTemplate.spec 레벨)
          volumes:
            - name: nfs-backup
              nfs:
                server: "192.168.1.100"    # NFS 서버 IP
                path: "/export/elasticsearch/backup"
                readOnly: false
            
            - name: nfs-snapshot
              nfs:
                server: "192.168.1.100"
                path: "/export/elasticsearch/snapshot"
                readOnly: false
          
          imagePullSecrets:
            - name: search-harbor-cowave-secret
    
    - name: data
      count: 3
      # ... 유사하게 추가
```

#### B. 방법 2: PV/PVC를 먼저 생성하고 참조

별도 파일에서 PV/PVC 생성:

```yaml
# nfs-pv-pvc.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolume
metadata:
  name: elasticsearch-nfs-pv
spec:
  capacity:
    storage: 100Gi
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteMany
  persistentVolumeReclaimPolicy: Retain
  nfs:
    server: "192.168.1.100"
    path: "/export/elasticsearch"

---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: elasticsearch-nfs-pvc
spec:
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteMany
  storageClassName: ""
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 100Gi
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      pv: elasticsearch-nfs-pv
```

그 후 values에서:
```yaml
volumes:
  - name: nfs-backup
    persistentVolumeClaim:
      claimName: elasticsearch-nfs-pvc
```

#### C. 방법 3: StorageClass 기반 (NFS Provisioner 사용)

NFS Provisioner가 설치된 경우:
```yaml
volumeClaimTemplates:
  - metadata:
      name: elasticsearch-nfs
    spec:
      storageClassName: nfs-filesystem  # 클러스터의 NFS 스토리지클래스
      accessModes:
        - ReadWriteMany
      resources:
        requests:
          storage: 100Gi
```

### 6. 중요 고려사항

#### A. volumeClaimTemplates vs volumes 차이

| 항목 | volumeClaimTemplates | volumes |
|------|---------------------|---------|
| 사용처 | 데이터 저장소 (자동 생성) | 추가 스토리지 |
| 워크로드 | StatefulSet 자동 생성 | 기존 리소스 참조 |
| 특징 | Pod당 별도 PVC | 모든 Pod 공유 가능 |
| NFS 사용 | 가능하나 비추천* | 권장 |

*주의: NFS는 ReadWriteMany를 지원하므로 StatefulSet에서 volumeClaimTemplates 대신 ReadWriteMany PVC를 사용하는 것이 더 효율적

#### B. NFS 마운트 옵션 최적화

```yaml
volumes:
  - name: nfs-backup
    nfs:
      server: "192.168.1.100"
      path: "/export/elasticsearch/backup"
      readOnly: false
      # mountOptions는 PV에서 설정:
```

또는 PV에서:
```yaml
spec:
  mountOptions:
    - nfsvers=4,2
    - tcp
    - hard
    - timeo=600
    - retrans=2
    - rsize=8192
    - wsize=8192
```

#### C. 보안 고려사항

```yaml
securityContext:
  fsGroup: 1000          # Elasticsearch 사용자 UID
  fsGroupChangePolicy: OnRootMismatch
```

#### D. 네트워크 경로 설정

```yaml
# 클러스터 내 NFS 서비스 사용 가능
server: "nfs-service.storage.svc.cluster.local"

# 또는 외부 NFS 서버
server: "192.168.1.100"
```
